acceptanceCriteria.text: `publish` job's checkout step pins an explicit trusted ref (e.g. `${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}` or a fixed base SHA), independent of the triggering event's `github.sha`.

A structural workflow test (extending `scripts/validate-actions.mjs` or equivalent) asserts that every job carrying a `contents: write` (or other elevated) permission checks out a trusted ref rather than the event-default ref.
`review-pages/src/publish-to-pages.mjs`'s handling of the downloaded artifact continues to treat it as inert data (no new code-execution path introduced for artifact content).

issue.title: fix: pin Review Pages publish job checkout to a trusted ref
